title: kiseki-interest-export v1
description: The only document KISEKI prepares for the world outside the machine: the corrected profile's interests with month-level time, and the lifecycle stages of those same topics. What is absent is the design (ADR-0047, ADR-0069).

schema.description: The document names its contract. A consumer reads this first and refuses what it does not recognise.

version.description: Anything that does not fit this shape changes it by a visible version bump.

exported_on.description: The day the export was made. A day, never a moment: an exact timestamp is a fact about the owner.

interests.description: Strongest first, by score times confidence. Empty is valid: a library with nothing to say says nothing.

stages.description: Lifecycle stages, only ever for topics the interests carried out with them.

interest.description: One interpretation. It carries its own confidence, because an interpretation with no confidence is an opinion wearing a fact's clothes.

topic.description: A place topic never leaves, named or not: a list of places is a movement history.

score.description: How strongly the evidence points at the topic.

confidence.description: How far the evidence can be trusted to support the reading at all. Required, always.

first_seen.description: The month the topic first appeared. Months only; a day would locate the owner in time.

last_seen.description: The month it last appeared. Not before first_seen -- a rule no schema can express, checked by the conformance kit.
